description: Build a native Android (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose) clone of the Daily OK iOS app with full feature parity. The Android app connects to the same Supabase backend and edge functions, uses FCM instead of APNs, Google Play Billing instead of StoreKit 2, and Room instead of SwiftData. Target Android 8.0+ (API 26+), Material Design 3.

App name 'Daily OK' in strings.xml

(2) Native users expect the bottom bar's safe-area / home-indicator handling, gesture-edge zones, and Dynamic Type / large-text scaling — the platform bar gives all of this for free; the custom component would need bespoke insets and font-scale clamps. (3) Existing deep-link routing already binds to AppState.selectedTab on iOS and the equivalent rememberSaveable index on Android; preserving that against a custom nav requires re-binding the source-of-truth which adds risk. (4) FloatingBottomNav stays available for sub-navigation surfaces (paywall sub-tabs, settings sub-screens, future modal flows) so the prior component work is not wasted. acceptanceCriteria: ContactQuickActions uses the correct 'tel:\(number)' scheme instead of the non-standard 'tel://\(number)'
The sms: action remains correct and consistent
Call/FaceTime/Text tint colors are verified to meet AA contrast on the thin-material glass background (adjust if not)
Verified: Call launches the dialer with the number prefilled
userStories.notes: P2, escalation-critical. ios/DailyOK/Views/Components/ContactQuickActions.swift:~23-25 (tel:// malformed; sms: is fine).

userStories.title: Receiver feedback fixes: offline audio cue, durable Undo, clearing snooze text
userStories.description: As a receiver (often low-vision/elderly), I want an audible cue when an offline check-in is saved, an Undo button that survives the app backgrounding within the grace window, and snooze confirmations that clear, so that the home screen state is always trustworthy.
acceptanceCriteria: When audio confirmation is enabled and the check-in is saved offline, a distinct spoken phrase is played (e.g. 'Saved. Will send when you're back online.') instead of silence

The Undo affordance is derived from a persisted deadline (e.g. lastCheckIn.checkedInAt + undoGraceSeconds) so it survives loadStatus()/foreground reloads within the grace window, not only the in-memory performCheckIn path
snoozeConfirmation is cleared on reload/after check-in (or auto-dismisses) so a stale 'Snoozed for 15 minutes' can't reappear
Verified: background and return within the grace window still shows Undo
userStories.notes: P2 a11y/trust. ios/DailyOK/Views/Receiver/ReceiverHomeView.swift:~307-312 (audio gated on !isOffline), ~463-484 (Undo from undoableUntil only); ReceiverViewModel.swift:~189-215,~548-558 (snoozeConfirmation never cleared; undoableUntil not repopulated in loadStatus).

userStories.title: CelebrationOverlay: cancel timer on early dismiss and announce to VoiceOver
userStories.description: As a user, I want the celebration overlay to stop cleanly if it's dismissed early and to be announced to VoiceOver, so that completion handlers don't fire on a torn-down view and blind users get the confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: The 1.0s completion chain is driven by a cancellable Task / guarded by isVisible so onComplete and state mutations don't fire after the parent flips isVisible=false
On appear, the overlay posts a UIAccessibility announcement (e.g. 'Success') so VoiceOver users get the confirmation
The success element has appropriate accessibility traits and is focusable
Verified: dismissing before the timer elapses does not call onComplete
userStories.notes: P2. ios/DailyOK/Views/Components/CelebrationOverlay.swift:~76-88 (DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter, unconditional; no a11y announcement).

userStories.title: Email auth flow: focus chaining, email-format validation, enforce stated password policy
userStories.description: As a user signing up or resetting a password, I want keyboard 'Next' to move between fields, my email to be format-checked, and the password rules I'm shown to actually be enforced, so that I don't get misleading affordances or a server rejection after a 'Good' meter.
acceptanceCriteria: Name -> Email -> Password fields use @FocusState chaining so the keyboard 'Next' button advances focus (currently a no-op)
Email is format-validated before sign-up and before sending a password reset; an invalid/typo'd email prompts correction instead of showing the generic 'you'll receive a link' success
The stated password policy (10+ chars with uppercase, lowercase, and a number) is enforced client-side before Create Account is enabled, and the strength meter is reconciled with that policy
Verified: an 8-char password is rejected client-side with guidance matching the displayed rule
userStories.notes: P3. ios/DailyOK/Views/Auth/AuthView.swift:~210-237 (no focus chain), ~244 (policy copy), ~252 (forgot pw); AuthViewModel.swift:~291 (no pre-validation), ~381-401 (reset only checks .isEmpty); PasswordStrength.swift:~39-66 (diversity-only meter).

userStories.title: Surface save errors in Caregiver Digest / Data Retention and enlarge schedule buttons
userStories.description: As a user saving digest or data-retention settings, I want failures shown instead of silently swallowed, and as a caregiver editing a custom schedule I want comfortably-sized add/remove buttons, so that I'm never unsure whether a save worked and the controls aren't fiddly.
acceptanceCriteria: CaregiverDigestView.save and DataRetentionView.saveRetention surface save failures via toast/alert (matching ReceiverSettingsView), not just Log.error
The transient green 'Saved' capsule is marked accessibilityHidden and the accompanying UIAccessibility announcement is confirmed to fire
The custom-schedule minus.circle.fill / plus.circle buttons get .frame(minWidth: 44, minHeight: 44) and .contentShape(Rectangle()) to meet the 44pt hit target
Verified: a failed digest/retention save shows an error
userStories.notes: P3. ios/DailyOK/Views/Settings/CaregiverDigestView.swift:~64-73,~109-126; SettingsView.swift:~326-335,~366-387 (saveRetention); ReceiverSettingsView.swift:~364-389 (sub-44pt schedule buttons).

userStories.title: Consistency math and receiver-limit counting honor real schedule and status
userStories.description: As an owner, I want consistency percentages and the receiver-limit count to reflect each receiver's actual schedule and active status, so that weekday-only/paused receivers don't drag consistency below 100% and deactivated receivers don't consume a paywall slot.
acceptanceCriteria: WeeklySummary computes totalExpected from each receiver's actual scheduled days (not receiverCount * 7), so weekday-only/paused/partially-enrolled receivers aren't unfairly penalized
currentReceiverCount used for the maxReceivers gate excludes deactivated receivers (status != .deactivated)
Average check-in time uses the receiver's timezone (consistent with US-IOS059)
Verified: a weekday-only receiver who checks in every scheduled day shows 100% consistency
userStories.notes: P3 correctness. ios/DailyOK/ViewModels/DashboardViewModel.swift:~459-462 (totalExpected = receiverCount*7), ~467 (avg tz); FamilyView.swift:~18-24 (count includes deactivated/invited).

userStories.title: Force-update fallback URL and cross-role tab-selection mapping
userStories.description: As a user, I never want the force-update screen to be a dead end, and as a viewer I don't want a stale tab selection to land me on the wrong screen, so that navigation is robust across edge cases.
acceptanceCriteria: If both the server updateURL and bundled Configuration.appStoreURL fail to parse, the force-update screen still offers a working action (hardcoded App Store URL or an App Store search), so the CTA is never permanently disabled
appState.selectedTab is clamped/translated per role so a value valid for owners (e.g. .family at index 2) doesn't land a viewer on the wrong tab after a role change or deep link
Verified: switching roles or deep-linking does not leave a viewer on an unexpected tab, and the update button is always actionable
userStories.notes: P3 edge cases. ios/DailyOK/App/ContentView.swift:~187-199 (button disabled when updateURL nil); AppState.swift:~8 (selectedTab shared across Owner/Viewer tab sets).
